correctness.rationale: Recomputed the nonproper but positive Lyapunov function H_mu and verified dH/dt=-exp(-2 mu y)x^4 by independent SymPy differentiation. To obtain global boundedness, the proof separately uses finite one-sided excursion integrals (cubic drift) to bound y and then inward x drift; invoking Lyapunov properness alone would be false. LaSalle forces convergence to zero. Independently integrated the polar perturbation jets, obtaining return-radius coefficient -3pi/4 and physical period coefficient pi*mu^2/3. Reciprocal squared section radii grow (3pi/2)n+O(sqrt n), so the O(n^-3/2) errors are summable and summing the physical period yields the exact log phase (2mu^2/9), not just a leading-order frequency. Within-turn differences vanish because rho_n tends to zero. mu=0 follows by smooth specialization and its Euclidean energy.
